data.content: Root cause confirmed: released sync never invokes v2 compaction, while Diffinite v8 binds inbox ownership to a random per-connection SSH credential UUID. The production provider-evidence prerequisite shipped at Quilt d59b506019222225a94cd96e0c42a7491f6bd982 and correctly fails closed until v9. Activation now needs operator approval for a persistent Git authorization change to stable SHA-256 SSH-public-key inbox scopes.
